content: What the superior man seeks is in himself; what the small man seeks is in others.
author: Confucius
explanation: In The Analects, Book XV, Chapter 20, Confucius explains that genuine mastery and social harmony arise from unwavering adherence to moral cultivation. When the individual anchors their mind in self-examination, their outer life naturally achieves equilibrium and dignity.
practicalInsight: Apply this wisdom today by stepping back to examine the root of your intention before taking irreversible action.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody this principle of quiet self-mastery in your most challenging interaction today?
